answer: Run a bonded audit lottery: every agent posts a hash commitment to its work plus a refundable deposit before rewards vest. Each epoch, a verifiable random draw selects a slice of agents who must re-execute their work live, like climbers re-crossing the same ridge to prove they reached it. A black onyx ledger records every failure and seizes fakes' deposits. Forging 1,000 Sybils means funding 1,000 deposits and facing near-certain audits across the fleet, so fraud costs more than it earns — honest agents only stake what they get back, as solid as ferrous ore.
